system_thesis_interpretation: The intended organism converts ordinary public action--outcome episodes into target-independent local proposals, gives those proposals epistemic status only through chronologically later public intervention evidence, deterministically compiles supported atoms, transports the cumulative within-life atom set into an explicit or parametric memory substrate, and uses a recurrent goal-conditioned resolver to reconstruct only the path needed for a later action. Local edges may accumulate over several DREAM/SLEEP cuts within one life, but per-life state must reset rather than accumulate across distinct lives; across-life learning of phi is only a dormant future hypothesis. The fixed scripted deck deliberately isolates representation and use from policy-induced experience. D0 is therefore a CPU instrument-and-falsifier layer, not an observation of DREAM, THINK, LoRA, online learning, or organism-level behavior. A useful future result requires the whole path to matter behaviorally while preventing a target, query scaffold, candidate recognizer, explicit graph traversal, raw context, or pretrained answer prior from bypassing it.
graph_delta_interpretation: N01--N08 form the only potentially executable post-ratification D0 subgraph: finite twin world, canonical public contract, append-only semantic lifecycle, deterministic one-edge compiler, common one-atom reader fixtures, exact controllers, immutable snapshots, and estimator/resource/claim fixtures. N09--N12 preserve but do not activate the model-backed THINK, DREAM, per-life LoRA, scientific assay, and on-policy organs; N13 makes later activation a new human decision. The scientifically important chain is E01/E02 common source experience, E03/E04 target-blind proposal search, E05 independent later support, E06 deterministic admission, E07/E08 substrate transport, E09/E10 local read and on-demand path construction, and E11/E12 sequential action with temporary replanning. E14 blocks evaluation-to-memory writes, while E15 correctly reserves rather than demonstrates the action--experience feedback edge. This decomposition prevents DREAM from being credited with truth, SLEEP with discovery, or LoRA with graph construction. It also means D0 can validate contracts and falsifiers only: scripted fixtures cannot validate the behavior of dormant model-mediated edges. The common reader equalizes model-visible result bytes, not hidden candidate computation, storage capacity, latency, training cost, or retrieval intelligence, so protocol and resource credit must remain explicit.
loop_delta_interpretation: The required causal order is source action, ordinary public outcome, immutable prefix cut, target-independent DREAM proposal, later distinct-root public prediction check, append-only status in a later snapshot, deterministic SLEEP compilation, cumulative within-life memory rebuild, then a fresh held-out goal whose THINK trace may query local atoms and issue one action at a time. Early claims proposed at 0.5C can first become supported at 0.75C; recent claims wait until 1.5C--2C; a proposal first made at terminal 2C cannot enter positive data. Later suffixes never rewrite earlier status, corpus, catalog, cache, or adapter inputs. During evaluation, current-item outcomes may cause bounded backtracking but cannot write durable memory or affect another item. L01 and L02 are CPU reference loops only; L03--L06 are dormant model/science loops, and L07 is the separately designed on-policy flywheel. Repeated DREAM samples are search attempts, not evidence, and repeated SLEEP exposure is training dosage, not support. Thus recurrence in this bundle means within-life checkpoint accumulation and within-item adaptive reads, not learned recurrence, recurrence superiority, or continued improvement across lifetime scale.
claim_delta_interpretation: A green D0 supports only protocol-conformance and finite-instrument statements: deterministic twins, exact-controller headroom, schema/visibility enforcement, lifecycle/compiler invariants, estimator arithmetic, and authority isolation. It cannot establish memory transport, composition by a model, useful action, online learning, or any scientific claim. A later fixed-deck study could separately support: memory transport only from same-atom-set E-text versus E-LoRA retention; composition only from adaptive versus committed-query closure plus causally faithful cited-read interventions; action improvement only from held-out sequential return contrasts; authentic binding only from S-bind together with S-life and T-swap; and organism-level value only from the complete frozen protocol. DREAM earns proposal-formation credit only if it is target-blind and its claims later pass public support; the compiler earns transformation credit; reader/resolver earn retrieval/composition credit; LoRA earns recognition-assisted transport credit unless unaided read and causal tests justify more. The PCFL-13 scale firewall is essential: the entire reusable backbone is 13 mappings, about 16.7 bits before excluded exceptions, and is supportable by 2C. Even a positive result is only fixed-deck post-working-window retention under an imposed 8192-token resolver budget, not post-native-context scaling. No repetition to 16C, single endpoint, or dormant edge can support scaling, crossover, continual improvement, recurrent-sleep superiority, on-policy learning, A4 revision, or the action--experience flywheel.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: Cognition is intended to see only the static mode prompt; THINK's canonical current public goal/state or DREAM's eligible replay; bounded workspace, repeat state, and budgets; and the last canonical one-atom FOUND return or NOT_FOUND. Hidden mappings, twins, proofs, solver actions, scorer truth, split/rejection metadata, support/provenance/status, candidate lists/ranks/scores/counts, backend identity, corpus/adapter metadata, runtime timing/retries/caches, other lives/items, and evaluation outcomes are forbidden. D0 and isolated audit/scorer code may see hidden truth solely to generate, solve, score, and test the instrument. The only legal target-derived transformation is an exact copy of an already visible typed handle or enum, with an audit origin; the primary query is generic anchor-only, catalogs are enumerated before targets, and backend errors are failures rather than informative NOT_FOUND returns. These rules directly target the historical target-signature, candidate-recognition, answer-prior, and backend-channel failures. However, a declarative matrix and equal return schema do not themselves prove noninterference: exact serialized goal/state/operation schemas, target-pair byte collisions, candidate freeze order, fixed timing barrier behavior, parser rejection, file/process isolation, and actual future model-call envelopes must be mechanically bound and re-audited. D0 fixtures can prove the reference checker enforces this contract, not that a later implementation with models and external backends has no side channel.
acceptance_test_interpretation: AT01: the raw proposal hash is 22af8508d3ccedd8ac0acda1a6aae53775e6843e8a37b6cad7ed7adea88ccaff and all 11 listed context hashes match; validation establishes exact proposal binding, not ratification. AT02: static and dynamic reachability denial is the correct D0 firewall, but must cover transitive imports and fail before credential, network, device, model, adapter, split, or promotion side effects. AT03: counterfactual twins are the main paired-world identifiability device; the evidence must include byte-identical model-visible target goal/state prefixes for each paired target, not only initial/source bytes before a swapped action, plus matched marginals and suffix noninterference. AT04: exhaustive uniqueness, minimality, source-target nonmatch, block chronology, disjoint twin answers, and method-blind rejection are necessary to show fresh constructive opportunity rather than replay; structural rejection must never be conditioned on any controller. AT05: Bayes-N is the strongest principled no-lifetime reference because it gets the accepted-deck prior, all current-item public evidence, adaptive legal actions, and the full six-action horizon. Its exactness requires rational probability mass, an explicit target-selection conditioning rule, lexicographic ties, Bellman certificates, and full-family equivalence for every quotient state used; the quotient alone is insufficient. AT06: the uncurated joint Bayes, exact-memory, shortcut, null, bad-assignment, and twin-assignment gate establishes finite-world necessity/headroom only if exact memory is restricted to causally eligible source-derived atoms at the tested cut and its access/action budget is frozen. An oracle receiving hidden mappings would show theoretical information value, not lifetime-memory usability. Nonpositive gain correctly fails. AT07: strict JCS/NFC/typed-handle parsing and field-origin receipts are required to close schema laundering; the actual schemas must be hash-bound rather than chosen during implementation. AT08: exhaustive goal/query/catalog/order/error/timing perturbations plus one-atom identical returns are the right leakage assay. Generic, typed, open, native, and generative variants must remain separately labeled because candidate enumeration and recognition can carry intelligence even when visible bytes match. AT09: atom identity, root-cluster deduplication, pre-fit plus later prediction, separating panels, append-only status, alias-before-cycle logic, diamonds, and taint rejection operationalize support substantially better than proposal multiplicity or verifier truth. They establish finite-world operational support, not causal independence of episodes or external scientific truth. AT10: supported-only deterministic compilation and exactly one semantic edge per view block direct solution storage; zero direct closure does not imply adaptive composition, which belongs to AT12. AT11: call-state sealing, INDETERMINATE post-dispatch handling, repeat visibility, suffix immutability, canaries, evaluation write denial, and quarantine are required because regeneration or cache leakage can create apparent performance. D0 simulates provider boundaries only; future provider execution needs the same audit anew. AT12: minimal cited-slot cuts followed by all-cut masking and type-matched twin substitution are materially stronger than a valid-looking dependency DAG. For item-level constructive credit, forks must begin from the exact sealed pre-decision state, change only the intervention bytes, cut every redundant cited path, and require the registered semantic action change; scripted D0 traces validate the checker but supply no model credit. AT13: S-life is a whole-pipeline history falsifier, S-bind is the closest content-binding intervention because it preserves the frozen corpus envelope, and T-swap tests authentic cross-twin assignment; none may be collapsed into a generic shuffle. An impossible derangement invalidates the generator. AT14: fixed disjoint splits, pair-level aggregation, failure-as-zero, paired seeds, exhaustive 2^16 sign flips, studentization, Romano--Wolf stepdown, grid-inverted bounds, Holm secondary families, and no outcome-dependent replacement define the future finite-sample decision. The first 12 masked confirmation pairs cannot alter the fixed 16. AT15: the roster covers standard/no-memory, exact Bayes, full transcript, summary/context, raw retrieval, reflection, common/native linked memory, structured text, direct/raw/experiential/oracle/generative LoRA, and three binding controls. It is adequate for a ledger-bounded protocol comparison only; equal source and visible return bytes do not establish fixed memory, fixed compute, or efficiency. AT16: deterministic CPU practicality and isolation are legitimate D0 engineering gates, but the full-oracle CPU ceiling must be explicitly budgeted before it can be pass/fail. AT17: the linter must reject over-credit and enforce negative dispositions, especially the fixed-deck, post-working-window, resource-qualified PCFL-13 scale firewall. AT18: fresh review can accept or reject frozen D0 conformance but cannot authorize D2, a model, GPU, LoRA, locked data, or a claim; an advocate cannot override rejection and repairs require new lineage.
assumptions: The architecture_change_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the raw change.json bytes, not a canonicalized semantic hash.
D0 may exercise only deterministic local CPU reference code and synthetic fixtures after exact human ratification; every model-backed object in the graph remains inert.

Distinct evaluation lives reset all per-life semantic, adapter, optimizer, index, cache, process, file-descriptor, and RNG state; cumulative memory means cumulative cuts within one life, not memory transfer across lives.

The exact authentic-memory controller is intended to consume only public-source-derived, causally eligible canonical atoms available at the relevant sealed cut, not hidden world mappings or scorer proofs.
The target generator and every structural rejection predicate are fixed before method behavior is observed, and target handles and semantic skins are independent of latent mappings.
Same-corpus text/LoRA comparison means identity of the canonical semantic atom set while physical views, storage, training, candidate computation, and resources remain separately ledgered.

Any future scientific stage must execute model-backed versions of the visibility, baseline, mask/substitution, isolation, and resource audits; passing their D0 scripted fixtures is not inherited scientific evidence.

ambiguities.question: Which exact JSON schemas, key names, enum values, field types, normalization rules, and operation payload layouts define every goal, state, event, query, return, workspace, proposal, status, manifest, and resource object?
ambiguities.impact: Note 47 enumerates semantic fields and canonicalization rules but the context binds no schema files. If D0 authors choose these bytes during implementation, target/query leakage and parser behavior become unreviewed scientific design choices despite AT01 and AT07 calling the bundle exact.

ambiguities.question: What exact seeds, protocol-hash derivation, pair manifests, target decks, lifetime orderings, and ordered reserve streams instantiate the 8 DEV, 64 CPU, 6 calibration, 16 confirmation, and 16 reserve pairs?
ambiguities.impact: The split counts, namespaces, rejection rules, and no-replacement policy are specified, but the actual manifests are not context files. Creating them after implementation can expose the instrument to deck selection or change the conditional Bayes prior.

ambiguities.question: Does the exact authentic-memory controller receive the complete eligible canonical atom set directly, or must it use the one-atom reader and the same query/operation budget as a future resolver?
ambiguities.impact: Direct graph access is a useful information-theoretic ceiling, while bounded reader access tests interface headroom. Conflating them makes AT06's claim that lifetime causal memory is useful stronger than its evidence.

ambiguities.question: How is the uniform accepted-deck prior conditioned on target generation, joint-twin acceptance, observable target fields, and any rejected proposals, and which exact empirical 90th-percentile convention applies to 64 pair values?
ambiguities.impact: Different conditioning or quantile conventions can change the Bayes-N ceiling and therefore generator acceptance. Full-versus-quotient equivalence cannot resolve a wrongly specified prior.

ambiguities.question: Does S-bind preserve four compiler views per atom, as sections 7 and 10's compiler definition, N04, E07, and AT10 imply, or six view counts, as note 47 section 10 states?
ambiguities.impact: This internal mismatch prevents an exact S-bind envelope and could change corpus size, token distribution, and the binding effect tested by AT13.

ambiguities.question: What is the separately declared maximum wall time, cores, memory, and energy budget for the full exact CPU oracle/property suite?
ambiguities.impact: AT16 specifies a five-minute simulator micro-budget but refers to an otherwise absent full-suite budget, so its second performance condition is not currently decidable.

ambiguities.question: Must every paired A2/A3 item have byte-identical complete model-visible goal and initial-state bytes across twins, with differences arising only after a swapped mapping is touched?
ambiguities.impact: The design strongly implies this, but AT03 explicitly names initial/source collisions while AT08 says only to use collision twins. An item-level goal/state collision certificate is needed to rule out target-side twin identification.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal is hash-bound but is not yet an exact executable benchmark bundle for schemas or split instances.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The prompts and prose are exact, but material goal/state/operation schemas and actual split/seed manifests are not among the bound context files. AT07 and AT14 can test choices after they are made; they cannot retroactively make those choices part of the ratified architecture.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Before schema or generator implementation, add the canonical schema files and frozen D0/split manifest-generation bytes to a successor hash-bound artifact, or explicitly narrow this ratification to implementing non-semantic scaffolding and returning those bytes for another human decision.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: AT06's falsification language is too strong unless the exact-memory controller's information source and access budget are frozen.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: A controller handed hidden mappings or unrestricted graph state can prove that extra world information has value and that target-only shortcuts fail, but it does not prove that the scripted source life contains recoverable supported memory or that the common reader can deliver it within the future resolver budget.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Register two separately named controllers: a hidden-graph oracle ceiling and an authentic source-derived exact-memory controller with a frozen causal cut, atom set, reader/interface, and budget. Attribute lifetime-memory necessity only to the latter and retain the former as a world-solvability ceiling.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The future co-primary confirmation rules are insufficient for a broad statement that compiled experiential memory improves action, because they can pass while E-LoRA loses to N, CTX-C, CTX-H, R-rec, or X-text on confirmation.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Calibration requires positive E-LoRA minus N and a text advantage over common baselines, but the locked confirmation co-primaries compare only D-LoRA, A-native, and E-text. A distributional reversal on the standard agent or honest raw-context baselines would not mechanically withdraw C03 as written, even though those are central bypasses and historical results show recognition/context protocols can carry performance.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Either add a locked confirmation requirement that E-LoRA remains positively useful versus N and report superiority or non-inferiority against the strongest applicable raw/native-context and retrieval baselines, or narrow the eligible sentence to the exact D-LoRA and A-native contrasts and forbid any unqualified action-improvement claim.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The binding-control specification cannot be exact while it simultaneously implies four and six compiler views.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The compiler, graph delta, and AT10 freeze exactly four one-edge views, but note 47's S-bind definition requires preserving six view counts. View count affects token length, candidate exposure, and training envelope, so this is not cosmetic.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Ratify one view count and update every compiler, S-bind, resource, and test clause to that same count before D0 implements fixtures.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: A passing scripted AT12 may validate the causal-credit checker but cannot itself support any claim that a future resolver used memory constructively.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Scripted traces can be authored to satisfy masking and twin substitution. Scientific causal credit requires the same frozen interventions on actual pre-decision model states and must separate behavioral success, valid trace structure, and intervention-supported constructive credit.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Keep D0's conclusion at checker conformance and make successful model-backed masked/twin forks a mandatory later evidence artifact for every credited item or preregistered credit rate.

open_questions: Does Rohin intend to ratify D0 implementation before the exact schemas and actual CPU/split manifest bytes are themselves hash-bound, or should those material bytes return through a successor architecture decision first?
Should exact authentic memory in AT06 use unrestricted eligible atoms as a ceiling or the common one-atom reader under the future resolver budget, and should a separate hidden-graph oracle be named?

Must a future positive confirmation remain better than the no-memory agent and strongest applicable raw/native-context baseline, or is the claim deliberately limited to D-LoRA, A-native, and same-corpus transport?
Should the compiler and S-bind contract use exactly four views or six?
What exact full-suite CPU resource budget makes AT16 decidable?
Does Rohin confirm that PCFL-13 can never support scaling, online-learning, recurrence-superiority, A4, or full-flywheel language even if every D0 and later fixed-deck gate passes?
